title: Diagnostic-only conserving known-gauge state analysis
trigger: accepted open-loop parent has a material known-gauge history gap
accepted_open_loop_parent: 20260823_27 locked H0 physical process; 20260823_31 attribute candidate was not promoted
material_gap_definition: 2019-2022 Gauge-observation RMSE_log is at least 0.10 below latent-support RMSE_log
analysis_method: monthly constrained network least squares on local release corrections; retained water returns to explicit fast/delayed stores and additional release is withdrawn from explicit stores
constraints: adjusted local fast and delayed releases nonnegative
adjusted fast and delayed end stores nonnegative
every release correction has an equal and opposite explicit store correction
routing is recomputed from adjusted local releases
interpretation_boundary: This is an at-gauge state-analysis upper-bound diagnostic. It is not an ungauged prediction product and does not validate fast/delayed partition.
